corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez text clearly reads 'ወይትቄበል' (Acts 28:30, 'and he received all who came in to him'), which directly corresponds to the Amharic Andemta gloss 'እየተቀበለ' on lines 10-11.
The glyph has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) vowel marker on the right leg ('ክሡተ', the canonical Ge'ez passive participle accusative used adverbially meaning 'openly', glossed as 'ገልጦ').
